name: Gigapixel Standard 2
description: Topaz Labs Gigapixel Standard 2 is a general-purpose precision image upscaler that balances detail, sharpness, and noise reduction while staying true to the source. It is the recommended default for photos, graphics, and print, with optional face recovery.

examples.name: Poster Upscale
examples.description: Upscale a 475-pixel scan of a 1938 national park poster 4x to 1900 pixels wide, with sharp lettering and clean edges. Poster: C. Don Powell, via the Library of Congress (no known restrictions).

code_snippets.label: typescript

examples.name: Small Photo Upscale
examples.description: Upscale a 640-pixel photo 4x to 2560 pixels wide. Standard 2 picks its own enhancement settings, so none are needed. Photo: NASA.

code_snippets.label: typescript

examples.name: Thumbnail Portrait
examples.description: Upscale a 127-pixel thumbnail of an 1863 portrait 6x to 762 pixels wide. Face recovery rebuilds a sharp face where a plain upscale smears it. Photo: Alexander Gardner, via the Library of Congress (no known restrictions).

image.description: Source image as a public HTTPS URL or a base64 data URI (JPEG, PNG, or TIFF)

output_width.description: Desired output width in pixels. If only one dimension is set, the other scales proportionally. If neither is set, the source resolution is kept (enhancement without upscaling)

output_height.description: Desired output height in pixels. If only one dimension is set, the other scales proportionally. If neither is set, the source resolution is kept (enhancement without upscaling)

crop_to_fill.description: Crop to fill the requested dimensions instead of letterboxing when the aspect ratio differs

face_enhancement.description: Run face recovery on detected faces

face_enhancement_creativity.description: Face recovery style, from realistic (0) to creative (1)

image.description: Time-limited presigned URL to the upscaled image
